description: Replacement of the existing windows of all units within 17-23 and 25-31, replacements of non-original doors to Flats 17A, 25A, 31A and 31B with timber insulated doors alongside installation of PV panels, ventilation upgrades, and roof / loft insulations within Flats 17A-D; 21A-C-D; 23B-C-D; 25A-D; 29A-B-C; 31A-B.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

<div>All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved.&nbsp;</div><div><br></div><div>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</div>

<p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works:</p><p>A) Details of all proposed insulation materials including product specifications</p><p>The work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>
